name: Rune of Accumulation
description: Place into an empty Augment Socket in a Ranged Weapon or pair of Gloves to apply its effect to that item. Once socketed it cannot be retrieved but can be replaced by other Augment items.

lines: Gain 3 Life per Enemy Hit with Attacks
Gain 1 Mana per Enemy Hit with Attacks
On Hitting an enemy, gains maximum added Cold damage equal to the enemy's Power for 20 seconds, up to a total of 32
